correctness.rationale: Direct proof: parity-support decomposition identifies the odd shift as two copies of the full binary two-shift meeting at zero. Five allowed 3-blocks reduce 256 Wolfram rules to 9 map patterns times 8 free invalid-neighborhood bits. Explicit two-block preimage formulas classify all five images and four surjective patterns. Integer characteristic polynomials t^2-t-1 and t(t^3-2t^2+t-1) give exact image entropies. The derivative has two coarse preimages, and the zero-source intersection gives three zero fibres. An independent standard-library finite enumeration checks all codes and languages n<=8; bounded enumeration is not substituted for infinite proof.
